**Detector or dataset**
Name, paper (title, venue, year, link).

**Code or data**
Link to the official code or data, and its licence.

**Why it is useful**
For example: token-level scores, a widely used baseline, a new type of anomaly.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for how detectors are added and checked
against the original code.
